scripts.dev: node scripts/preflight.mjs && node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --ui --import=./.emulator-data "node scripts/dev.mjs"
scripts.emu: node scripts/preflight.mjs && node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --import=./.emulator-data
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage "node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs" && node scripts/finalize-export.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs"
